shortDescription: Australia's CSL ASX:CSL on Monday appointed Gordon Naylor as its chair, effective from March 31, 2027.Naylor, who has been serving as the biotechnology company's interim CEO and managing director since February 2026, will replace the current chair, Brian McNamee.
